# Rkkp Akdb

This wiki maps the Danish Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen, or AKDB), capturing the clinical quality indicators, regional performance metrics, and operational frameworks used to monitor acute surgical care across Denmark. Built from the 2023 and 2024 AKDB annual reports, it preserves raw document extracts, source provenance, and structured comparisons of hospital-level compliance and mortality outcomes. The knowledge base catalogs the healthcare entities, clinical scoring systems, and thematic topics that define how patient data is captured, benchmarked, and governed by Denmark's regional health authorities.

## Start Here

- [[comparisons/index|Comparisons]] — Analyze structured performance data, tracking how regions and hospitals meet national standards for antibiotic administration, surgical response times, and mortality rates.
- [[entities/index|Entities]] — Explore the hospitals, regional health authorities, clinical scoring systems, and digital registries that form the backbone of Danish acute surgical care.
- [[topics/index|Topics]] — Investigate the thematic frameworks governing healthcare quality, including data privacy, coding uncertainties, clinical evidence, and compliance evaluations.
- [[sources/index|Sources]] — Review the provenance records and page indexes for the foundational 2023 and 2024 AKDB annual reports.
